          <button class="close" id="closeAvailability" aria-label="关闭">
            ×
          </button>
        </header>
        <div class="availability-grid">
          <section class="card status-card">
            <div class="status-ring" id="statusRing">待查询</div>
            <b id="availabilityState">正在等待商户接口返回</b>
            <p id="availabilitySub">点击“查询接待能力”查看当前余量。</p>
          </section>
          <section class="card">
            <h3>行程与服务信息</h3>
            <div class="data-rows" id="availabilityRows"><div class="data-row"><span>行程状态</span><b>出发旅客｜17:21｜待录入登机口</b></div><div class="data-row"><span>航旅纵横</span><b>待接入：航班、登机口与登机状态</b></div><div class="data-row"><span>商户位置</span><b>安检外｜安检外</b></div><div class="data-row"><span>商户接口</span><b>待接入：座位余量与接待能力</b></div></div>
            <div class="actions" style="margin-top: 13px">
              <button class="btn primary sm" id="checkCapacity">
                查询接待能力</button><button class="btn sm" id="simulateFull">演示无余量</button>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
        <p class="notice" id="availabilityNotice">
          本页用于展示航班信息、商户余量与一键预定的接入形态。实时数据须在获得航旅纵横及商户系统接口授权后返回；当前结果均为演示状态。
        </p>
        <div class="modal-actions">
          <button class="btn" id="returnSelect">返回重新选择</button><button class="btn primary hidden" id="reserve">一键预定</button>
        </div>
      </section>

    <div class="modal hidden" id="flightModal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="航班信息协同">

            <div class="flight-facts">
              <div class="flight-fact"><span>登机时间</span><b id="flightBoarding">待录入</b></div>
              <div class="flight-fact"><span>登机口</span><b id="flightGate">待录入</b></div>
              <div class="flight-fact"><span>安全办公窗口</span><b id="flightWindow">待计算</b></div>
              <div class="flight-fact"><span>登机提醒</span><b id="flightReminder">提前25分钟</b></div>
            </div>
          </section>
          <section class="flight-timeline">
            <h3>行程节点</h3>
            <div class="flight-steps">
              <div class="flight-step"><i>01</i><b>信息确认</b><span>航班号、时间、登机口</span></div>
              <div class="flight-step"><i>02</i><b>商务停留</b><span>匹配就近店铺与公共办公区</span></div>
              <div class="flight-step"><i>03</i><b>返回登机</b><span>倒计时与路线同步提醒</span></div>
              <div class="flight-step"><i>04</i><b>动态更新</b><span>登机口或状态变化即时提示</span></div>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
        <p class="flight-sync" id="flightSyncState">当前为协同界面示意；接入航旅纵横后可同步航班动态、登机口变化和登机状态。</p>
        <div class="modal-actions">
          <button class="btn" id="refreshFlight">刷新航班示意</button><button class="btn primary" id="useFlightInfo">应用到行程</button>
        </div>
